sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj
Nath For the Appellant : Mr. A. K. Sahani, Advocate For the State : Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra, A.P.P.
---
 Order No. 05 Dated 09th May, 2025
 I.A. No. 6160 of 2025
Heard the learned counsel for the respective parties.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
The appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable u/s 376(2)(n) of the I.P.C. and has been sentenced for R.I. for ten years along with a fine of Rs. 10,000/-.
It has been submitted that the appellant is in custody since 18.02.2020.
Learned Spl. P.P. though has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant, but has not disputed the period of custody undergone by the appellant.
Regard being had to the fact that the appellant has completed more than half of the sentence imposed upon him, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly, during pendency of this appeal, the appellant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(Rs. Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned trial court [Additional Judicial Commissioner-IV-cum- Special Judge, POCSO, Ranchi] in connection with POCSO Case No. 53 of 2020.
This I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.
